name: Question 10
problem:
![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/914604fe524d7151dddcaa875a8c92156b93108fdb5d062f4361a5d8fab0c1a6.png)

What is the vertex of the parabola shown above?
worked_solution:
The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.

![](/home/jake/Developer/Course_Academy/reference/mathacademy/question-capture/14096579/assets/fdff4ed4a9f4dfe49be43c605f612077620761633711ac03ff395fcc63704ca8.png)

Therefore, the coordinates of the vertex are $(2,8).$

Question 10

a

(0,8)

Submit
Correct
EXPLANATION

The vertex of a left-opening parabola is the right-most point of the parabola.
